message:
6 string literals reach the DOM from an expression: libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[text]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[value]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[defaultValue]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[srcdoc]` → "

Delete the row

" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.value]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.srcdoc]` → "

Delete the row

"
description: Sentences a `host` block binds to what an element of one tag draws: the `text` of an `<a>` or an `<option>`, the `value` and `defaultValue` of a field, a `<textarea>` or an `<output>`, and the `srcdoc` of an `<iframe>`, as a property and as an attribute. A host is any element — a selector may name none, and a consumer's class extending this one takes the block onto the element its own selector names (measured: `<a pctSub>` draws `Delete` from a base's `'[text]'`) — so each counts on `pct-widget` too, six.
